metadata.title: Nivolumab, Ipilimumab, Pemetrexed and Cisplatin Therapy
metadata.short_title: Nivolumab, Ipilimumab, Pemetrexed and Cisplatin Therapy
metadata.indication: First-line metastatic NSCLC in adults without a sensitising EGFR mutation or ALK translocation. Current NCCP wording is histology-broad; the suitability of this pemetrexed backbone still requires explicit histology review.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.source_title_exact: Nivolumab, Ipilimumab, PEMEtrexed and CISplatin Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy validation pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current official v4 PDFs audited including CTCAE v4 immune actions, 42-day schedule and component-specific chemotherapy rules. Partial assessment does not authorise treatment.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.histology_source_caveat: NCCP removed non-squamous from indication and eligibility in May 2025. The CheckMate 9LA whole-trial NSCLC result is not evidence that pemetrexed is suitable for every histology; confirm the actual backbone with the consultant.
metadata.schedule_summary: The first cycle lasts 42 days: all four medicines on Day 1, then nivolumab, pemetrexed and cisplatin on Day 22. Chemotherapy ends after those two visits. From Cycle 2, nivolumab continues on Days 1 and 22 and ipilimumab on Day 1 of each 42-day cycle. Immune treatment continues while appropriate until the cancer progresses, side effects require stopping, or up to 24 months without progression. Plans can change after review.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00714 Version 4. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: First-line metastatic non-squamous NSCLC without sensitising EGFR mutation or ALK translocation.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cycle 1: nivolumab/pemetrexed/platinum Days 1 and 22 plus ipilimumab Day 1. Cycle 2 onwards: nivolumab Days 1 and 22 plus ipilimumab Day 1; up to 24 months without progression.

eligibility: First-line metastatic NSCLC in adults without a sensitising EGFR mutation or ALK translocation. Current NCCP wording is histology-broad; the suitability of this pemetrexed backbone still requires explicit histology review.
Histologically confirmed Stage IV or recurrent NSCLC with no prior systemic anticancer therapy; ECOG 0–1; adequate organ function.
Confirm histology suitability of pemetrexed and use current NCCP prior PD-1/PD-L1 guidance.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, glucose, TFTs, HBsAg, HCV RNA and morning cortisol; hearing/CrCl if clinically indicated.
FBC and renal/liver profile before EACH Day 1 and Day 22 treatment; glucose and TFT before EACH 42-day cycle.
Ongoing symptoms and immune toxicity at each visit and between visits, including at least five months after last immune dose.
Disease monitoring follows the supervising consultant treatment plan; no invented fixed scan interval.
dose_modifications: All immune holds/stops apply jointly to nivolumab/ipilimumab. No immune dose reductions. Source Table 1 uses CTCAE v4.
Chemotherapy Table 3 uses current blood counts (nadir wording removed in v4). Dose changes are consultant decisions.
Pemetrexed dose levels 500 → 375 → 250 mg/m²; third reduction discontinue. Cisplatin 75 → 56 → 38 mg/m²; third reduction discontinue.
Pemetrexed below CrCl 45/dialysis and severe hepatic impairment are not recommended. Do not apply another regimen’s hepatic thresholds.

supportive_care.mapping_source: NCCP regimen v4 and NCIS antiemetics V8
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Induction high at both chemotherapy administrations; immune-only Day 1 low due to ipilimumab, Day 22 minimal with nivolumab alone.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
additional_supportive_care: Daily folate with lead-in and 21-day tail after last pemetrexed; B12 in preceding week; no automatic B12 maintenance after pemetrexed ends.
Immune alert card and at least five months post-treatment symptom vigilance.
Cisplatin pre/post hydration and electrolytes per local plan.
